order: The disposable-checkout sweep deleted a LIVE checkout mid-verification: git records RESOLVED worktree paths, while a live checkout's own handle may be spelled through a symlink (macOS /var -> /private/var) or an 8.3 short path (RUNNER~1), so the lexical live-set compare missed. Make the live-set exemption compare path IDENTITY, not string identity — resolve real paths when the path is on disk, and keep the existing lexical form as the fallback for registrations whose directory is already gone. Pin the regression with a reproducer that stands a live checkout up under an aliased tmp root (junction on Windows, symlink elsewhere); it must fail on every platform without the fix and skip cleanly where links cannot be created. Leave the sweep's structural ownership guard byte-unchanged: a registration is ours only when its own basename is `checkout` AND the parent directory's OWN BASENAME carries the `orchestra-verifier-` prefix, and that test must never become a substring match anywhere in the path.
claims: Path normalization now resolves real paths, with the lexical form kept as the fallback for paths already gone, so the live-set exemption holds however a live checkout's handle is spelled. The aliased-tmp-root reproducer (junction on Windows, symlink elsewhere, skipped where links are unavailable) fails without the fix and passes with it. The structural ownership guard came out byte-unchanged — own basename plus parent-basename prefix, still structural, still no substring matching. 97 passed, 0 failed.
